description: This file defines abstract base classes and data structures for storage interfaces used in distributed checkpointing within PyTorch. It includes classes for writing and reading checkpoint data, handling metadata, and planning storage operations.

classes.name: WriteResult
classes.description: Immutable data class representing the result of a write operation, including index, size, and storage data.

classes.name: StorageWriter
classes.description: Abstract base class defining the interface for writing checkpoint data in a distributed setting.

classes.name: StorageReader
classes.description: Abstract base class defining the interface for reading checkpoint data in a distributed setting.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Indicates a new checkpoint write or read is starting, with an optional checkpoint ID.

methods.name: set_up_storage_writer
methods.description: Initializes the storage writer instance, specifying if it is the coordinator.

methods.name: prepare_local_plan
methods.description: Performs storage-specific local planning for save or load operations.

methods.name: prepare_global_plan
methods.description: Performs centralized global planning for save or load operations.

methods.name: write_data
methods.description: Executes the data writing process, returning a Future with write results.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Finalizes the save process by writing metadata and marking success.

methods.name: validate_checkpoint_id
methods.description: Checks if a given checkpoint ID is supported by the storage.

methods.name: read_metadata
methods.description: Reads and returns the checkpoint metadata.

methods.name: read_data
methods.description: Performs data reading based on the plan, returning a Future.
